programme.purpose: Everyday meals, guests, studio sessions, dinners and parties.

breakfast-eggs.title: Scrambled eggs & sourdough
breakfast-eggs.description: Chives and slow-roasted tomatoes; yoghurt, granola and peach alongside.

chicken-tarragon.title: Roast chicken & tarragon
chicken-tarragon.description: Little Gem, new potatoes and house-mustard dressing.

hake-dinner.title: Hake, brown butter & capers
hake-dinner.description: Crushed Charlotte potatoes and fine green beans.

bethan-bread.title: Bread for the house
bethan-bread.description: Sourdough, seeded loaf and focaccia, baked for the table and everyday service.

bethan-morning-pastries.title: Morning pastries
bethan-morning-pastries.description: Croissants, pains au chocolat and brioche from the breakfast repertoire.

bethan-afternoon-baking.title: Something for the afternoon
bethan-afternoon-baking.description: Lemon cake, madeleines and financiers for tea, coffee and something sweet between meals.

warm-toastie.title: Something warm
warm-toastie.description: Soup with sourdough; a mushroom and Comté toastie with mustard and leaves; an omelette with toast; tomato and basil pasta.

sweet-baking.title: Something sweet
sweet-baking.description: Butter shortbread, dark-chocolate sea-salt sablés, fruit, brownies and house ice cream.

studio-break.title: Studio breaks
studio-break.description: Sandwiches, bowls, salads and pasta served in the rec room during a break.

journey-food.title: For the journey
journey-food.description: Breakfast bags, packed lunches and separately packed food gifts.

late-supper.title: A late return
late-supper.description: Prepared food and service from the duty team when the household returns late.

vanilla-syrup.title: Vanilla syrup
vanilla-syrup.description: For mixed drinks, milkshakes and desserts.

cordial-ginger.title: Ginger & lemongrass
cordial-ginger.description: Bright and gently warming. Shown with sparkling water and ice; still water is equally welcome.

cordial-passion.title: Passion fruit & lime
cordial-passion.description: Tropical fruit with a sharp citrus finish. Chilled and diluted to taste.

cordial-elderflower.title: Elderflower & lemon
cordial-elderflower.description: Light and floral. Sparkling water, ice and a slim lemon peel.

cordial-raspberry.title: Raspberry & lemon verbena
cordial-raspberry.description: Fragrant summer berries. Particularly good with sparkling water and ice.

cordial-blackcurrant.title: Blackcurrant & bay
cordial-blackcurrant.description: Deep fruit with a restrained herbal finish. Still or sparkling water, alongside food.

cordial-rhubarb.title: Rhubarb & orange · Spring
cordial-rhubarb.description: Tart rhubarb and bright orange. Chilled with sparkling water and ice.

cordial-blackberry.title: Blackberry & apple · Autumn
cordial-blackberry.description: Dark berries and orchard fruit. Served chilled with still or sparkling water.

tommys-margarita.title: Tommy’s Margarita
tommys-margarita.description: Tequila, fresh lime and agave. Shaken and served over ice.

old-fashioned.title: Old Fashioned
old-fashioned.description: Bourbon, sugar and bitters, with orange peel over a large cube.

dry-martini.title: Dry Martini
dry-martini.description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred cold, with a lemon twist.

availableFood.title: Something warm
availableFood.description: Soup with sourdough; a mushroom and Comté toastie with mustard and leaves; an omelette with toast; tomato and basil pasta.

availableFood.title: A substantial plate
availableFood.description: Chicken club sandwich with pickles; chicken-and-rice bowl; roast-chicken and tarragon salad with new potatoes.

availableFood.title: Something sweet
availableFood.description: Butter shortbread, dark-chocolate sea-salt sablés, fruit, brownies and house ice cream.

availableFood.title: Studio breaks
availableFood.description: Sandwiches, bowls, salads and pasta can be served in the rec room during a break. Food and drinks stay away from recording equipment and instruments.

availableFood.title: For the journey
availableFood.description: Breakfast bags, packed lunches and a separately packed food gift. Tell the team the departure time, journey and dietary requirements.

availableFood.title: A late return
availableFood.description: The duty team arranges suitable prepared food and service. A late supper does not depend on Rafael personally being on duty.
